Fill up the online application form in the prescribed format available on the website.

Submit the application before the last date, i.e., 24 September 2026 (midnight).

important_instructions: Detailed eligibility criteria and the application process are available on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in. Offline correction of any application or record will not be accepted; all uploaded documents must be clearly readable. Only income certificates issued by the competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Section-9 Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Ra0-9 dated 30.09.2021 (as amended), which are digitally verifiable online, will be considered valid. Only residence and caste certificates issued through online digital signature by the Tehsil, which are digitally verifiable, will be considered valid. For widow candidates, a death certificate and family register copy issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay will be accepted as proof. For divorced/separated women, a legal order issued by a competent court will be accepted. The number of advertised vacancies may increase, decrease, or the selection process may be stopped/restricted under special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Vacancy 2026 – Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 105 Anganwadi Karyakartri posts are being filled across 7 Child Development Projects (rural and urban) in Amroha district, as shown below. The notification states that the number of advertised vacancies may increase or decrease, or the selection process may be stopped or restricted, under special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for the post of Anganwadi Karyakartri. The candidate must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward for which the post is advertised. If no eligible candidate is available from that Gram Sabha, candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat may be considered. For posts in urban areas, the candidate must clearly mention the relevant ward number/name in the online residence certificate at the time of application. Preference will be given to widows/legally divorced/separated women from families living below the poverty line (BPL). If no BPL widow/divorced/separated woman is available from that Gram Sabha/Ward, then a widow/separated/divorced woman above the poverty line from the same Gram Sabha/Ward will be given preference in selection. If no such candidate is available as per the above priority order, selection will proceed based on merit as per educational qualification, following the provisions of the applicable government order. Two women from the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Karyakartri and Sahayika (helper) at the same Anganwadi Centre.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (Class 12) or its equivalent. Higher educational qualification, up to postgraduate level, will be given preference and the merit list will be prepared based on educational attainment.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on 01.07.2026, the applicant's age should be between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 35 years. The date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet/certificate will be considered valid for age determination. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Salary
content_sections.text: This is an honorarium-based (Manadeya) engagement rather than a regular salaried post. The specific honorarium amount is not mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a merit list prepared based on the educational qualification of eligible candidates from the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward/Nyaya Panchayat. Priority in selection is given first to BPL widow/divorced/separated women, then to above-poverty-line widow/divorced/separated women from the same area, and thereafter to other eligible candidates based on educational merit, as per the provisions of Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025 dated 17 September 2025. If any information, data, or educational records provided in the application are found to be incorrect or fabricated, the candidature will be rejected, with the applicant solely responsible for such errors. The entire process of application and selection will be conducted as per the provisions of the above-mentioned Government Order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official departmental website: http://upanganwadibharti.in Fill up the online application form in the prescribed format available on the website. Carefully and correctly fill in all details in the application form. Upload self-attested, clear, and legible copies of the required documents/records, as mentioned in the online form. Submit the application before the last date, i.e., 24 September 2026 (midnight). Applications will be accepted online only between 4 September 2026 and 24 September 2026, until midnight. No offline or corrected documents will be accepted after any errors are found.

Only residence and caste certificates issued through online digital signature by the Tehsil, which are digitally verifiable, will be considered valid. For widow candidates, a death certificate and family register copy issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay will be accepted as proof. faq.question: Q1. What is Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Amroha, to fill 105 honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakartri posts across 7 Child Development Projects in Amroha district, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 105 vacancies in total, distributed across 7 projects: Amroha Shahar (10), Amroha Dehat (9), Dhanaura (26), Gajraula (17), Gangeshwari (6), Hasanpur (12), and Joya (25).

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri posts?
faq.answer: Only women candidates who are residents of the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward (or, failing that, the concerned Nyaya Panchayat) are eligible, subject to meeting the age and qualification criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Anganwadi Karyakartri?
faq.answer: Minimum qualification is Intermediate (Class 12) or equivalent, with preference given to higher qualifications up to postgraduate level for merit purposes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applicant must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026, based on the date of birth recorded in the High School certificate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 4 September 2026 to 24 September 2026 (till midnight).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is via a merit list based on educational qualification, with priority first to BPL widow/divorced/separated women, then to above-poverty-line widow/divorced/separated women from the same area, and thereafter to other eligible candidates by merit.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through http://upanganwadibharti.in in the prescribed format, along with self-attested, clearly readable copies of the required documents.
